preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the valid range.
The number of edges provided must match the specified number m.

preconditions.expression: all(vertex_in_at_most_one_cycle(u, edges) for u in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Each vertex must belong to at most one simple cycle.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n space-separated integers.
Each output distance must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(d) <= n - 1 for d in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output distance must not exceed n - 1, the maximum possible distance in a tree with n nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(d == max_distance_to_leaf(i, edges) for i, d in enumerate(stdout.split(), start=1))
postconditions.description: Each output distance must be the maximum distance from the corresponding node to a leaf in the resulting tree.
